entities.summary: Éric Gélinas is a Canadian professional ice hockey defenceman for Lukko of the Liiga. He was selected in the second round, 54th overall, by the New Jersey Devils in the 2009 NHL entry draft. Gélinas has also previously played for the Colorado Avalanche.
